name: Wien Museum Gruppe
notes: Server-rendered /ausstellungen listing has two sliders: section#26817 'Aktuell' (current exhibitions, incl. the permanent 'Wien. Meine Geschichte' with no date -> extra.permanent, start=today) and section#26819 'Vorschau' (announced future exhibitions, up to ~9 months out e.g. Franz West und Wien Nov2026-May2027). A third section#26820 'Rückblick' lists past exhibitions and is skipped. Only 2 venues appear (Wien Museum Karlsplatz 1040, musa 1010) so district/address are hardcoded by venue-name lookup; a new venue name would come through with district/address null. Each record does one extra fetch of its detail page to scrape the 'Eintrittspreise' collapsible section text via ea.price() (heading is <h3> or <h2> inconsistently, regex handles both). Site only ever lists ~9 exhibitions total (current+preview); horizon_days is irrelevant here, nothing to paginate.
